# @armemon-library/cli

Interactive scaffolding CLI for React Native apps. Pick your plugins, answer a few questions, and get a
fully wired app with nothing left to hand-edit.

## Run it

Without installing anything:

```bash
npx @armemon-library/cli init react-native MyApp
```

Or install it once. That gives you two commands for the same CLI, `armemon` and the
shorter `memon`:

```bash
npm install -g @armemon-library/cli
```

```bash
armemon init react-native MyApp
```

New to armemon? The [user guide](https://github.com/armemon-dev/armemon-library/blob/main/docs/user-guide.md) explains every
command in plain words, what each plugin does, and how to use the plugins without the CLI.

---

# All commands and options

This list is made from the armemon CLI itself, so it always matches the version you have.

## Quick list

- `armemon init` — Scaffold a new app
- `armemon add` — Add a platform target to an app you already scaffolded
- `armemon create-screen` — Create a screen and register it in your navigator, param list and deep links
- `armemon remove-screen` — Remove a screen: unregister it, drop its types and deep link, delete its folder
- `armemon rename-screen` — Rename a screen everywhere: folder, component, route, types, deep link and navigate() calls
- `armemon plugin` — Add a plugin to this app, or take one out
- `armemon list` — List the plugins armemon can install (the same as armemon plugin list)
- `armemon doctor` — Check a scaffolded app's armemon wiring
- `armemon sync` — Re-align armemon's managed files, and move a legacy src/armemon/ to armemon/
- `armemon upgrade` — Move the app's @armemon-library packages to this CLI's versions, then sync
- `armemon create-slice` — Create a Redux slice and register it in your store config
- `armemon remove-slice` — Unregister a Redux slice and delete its file
- `armemon rename-slice` — Rename a Redux slice: its file, binding, store entry and action prefix
- `armemon link` — Read and edit the app's deep links
- `armemon set` — Set one option in a plugin's config
- `armemon create-component` — Create a component in a screen folder or the shared one (nothing is wired up)
- `armemon create-hook` — Create a hook in a screen folder or the shared one (nothing is wired up)

## Options that work on most commands

Each command below lists exactly which of these it takes.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--dry-run` | Show what would change, but save nothing. Always safe to try |
| `--dir <path>` | Run on a different app folder, like `--dir ./MyApp` |
| `--json` | Print the result as JSON, for scripts and CI |
| `--all-accept` | Ask no questions and use the defaults |
| `--no-verify` | Skip the checks armemon runs after a change. Faster |
| `--force` | Do it even when armemon would normally stop. Each command below says when |
| `--help` | Show help for that command in your terminal |

When a command fails, it tells you what went wrong and how to fix it. For more detail,
put `ARMEMON_DEBUG=1` in front of the command.

## JSON output, for scripts

With `--json`, a command prints one JSON object on stdout and nothing else. Every one
starts with the same two fields:

- `schemaVersion` — the version of the output's shape, now `1`. It only changes
  when a field is removed or changes meaning, so skip fields you don't recognise.
- `ok` — `true` when the command did everything it was asked. The exit code agrees:
  `0` when ok, `1` for a problem, `130` when it was cancelled.

When a command fails, the object is `{ "ok": false, "error": { "message": "…", "hint": "…" } }`.

## Commands

### `armemon init`

Scaffold a new app

| Subcommand | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `init react-native` | Scaffold a new React Native app |

### `armemon init react-native [appName]`

Scaffold a new React Native app

| Argument | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `[appName]` | App name — letters and numbers, starting with a letter *(optional — you are asked if you leave it out)* |

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--rn-version <version>` | React Native version (e.g. 0.76.0, or "latest") |
| `--pm <manager>` | Package manager: npm, yarn, pnpm or bun |
| `--language <lang>` | ts \| js (React Native ships no JS template; armemon converts) |
| `--logo <path>` | Splash logo image, relative to where you run this |
| `--platforms <list>` | Comma-separated: ios,android,web,windows,macos |
| `--plugins <list>` | Comma-separated plugin ids or package names (empty string for none) |
| `--all-accept` | Skip every prompt: every platform, every recommended plugin, and each question's own default |
| `--dry-run` | Print the resolved configuration and exit without writing anything |
| `--no-verify` | Skip armemon's own checks on the finished app (they run by default) |
| `--verify` | Run those checks (the default; accepted for explicitness) |
| `--json` | Print only a JSON summary on stdout (implies --all-accept) |

```bash
armemon init react-native MyApp
# every prompt answered with its default, every recommended plugin
armemon init react-native MyApp --all-accept
# pinned for CI, nothing interactive
armemon init react-native MyApp --pm pnpm --language ts --platforms ios,android,web --plugins redux,navigation --json
# see what it would do first
armemon init react-native MyApp --dry-run
```

### `armemon add <platform>`

Add a platform target to an app you already scaffolded

| Argument | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `<platform>` | Platform to add: ios, android, web, windows, macos |

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--dir <path>` | The app directory (defaults to the nearest one at or above here) |
| `--dry-run` | List what adding the platform would do, without changing anything |
| `--no-verify` | Skip armemon's checks on the result (they run by default) |
| `--json` | Print only a JSON summary on stdout (implies --all-accept) |
| `--all-accept` | Take every default instead of asking |

```bash
armemon add web
armemon add windows --dir ./MyApp
armemon add ios --json
```

### `armemon create-screen [name]`

Create a screen and register it in your navigator, param list and deep links

| Argument | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `[name]` | Screen name — Order, OrderScreen, or order-history *(optional — you are asked if you leave it out)* |

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--dir <path>` | The app directory (defaults to the nearest one at or above here) |
| `--full` | Create components/, hooks/, utils/ and assets/ folders |
| `--flat` | Create only index — no subfolders |
| `--register` | Register without asking; fail if there is no navigator |
| `--no-register` | Don't touch the navigator |
| `--navigator <name>` | Where to register: stack, tabs, drawer, a variable like Tab, or File:Variable |
| `--link <path>` | Deep-link path, e.g. order or order/:id |
| `--no-link` | Don't add a deep-link entry |
| `--params <list>` | Route params, e.g. "id:string,page?:number" (string, number, boolean) |
| `--initial` | Make it the navigator's initial route |
| `--modal` | Present it as a modal (stack navigators) |
| `--title <title>` | Header / tab title |
| `--force` | Replace the screen if it already exists |
| `--dry-run` | Show every change as a diff without writing anything |
| `--no-verify` | Skip armemon's checks on the result (they run by default) |
| `--json` | Print only a JSON summary on stdout (implies --all-accept) |
| `--all-accept` | Take every default instead of asking |

```bash
armemon create-screen Order
# typed route params, and a deep link that carries them
armemon create-screen Order --params "id:string,page?:number" --link order/:id
# a modal with a header title, in a stack
armemon create-screen Settings --modal --title Settings
# into a specific navigator, as its first route
armemon create-screen Feed --navigator Tab --initial
# just the file: no subfolders, no navigator, no link
armemon create-screen Order --flat --no-register --no-link
# look before writing, then do it without the checks
armemon create-screen Order --dry-run
armemon create-screen Order --json --no-verify
```

### `armemon remove-screen <name>`

Remove a screen: unregister it, drop its types and deep link, delete its folder

| Argument | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `<name>` | Screen name — Order, OrderScreen, or order-history |

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--dir <path>` | The app directory (defaults to the nearest one at or above here) |
| `--keep-files` | Unregister it but keep its folder |
| `--force` | Remove it even while code still navigates to it, or it is an initial route |
| `--dry-run` | Show every change as a diff without writing anything |
| `--no-verify` | Skip armemon's checks on the result (they run by default) |
| `--json` | Print only a JSON summary on stdout (implies --all-accept) |
| `--all-accept` | Take every default instead of asking |

```bash
armemon remove-screen Order
# unregister it but keep the folder
armemon remove-screen Order --keep-files
# remove it even though something still navigates to it
armemon remove-screen Order --force
armemon remove-screen Order --dry-run
```

### `armemon rename-screen <from> <to>`

Rename a screen everywhere: folder, component, route, types, deep link and navigate() calls

| Argument | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `<from>` | The screen to rename — Order, OrderScreen, or order |
| `<to>` | Its new name |

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--dir <path>` | The app directory (defaults to the nearest one at or above here) |
| `--link <path>` | A new deep-link path |
| `--keep-link` | Keep the current deep-link path even if it came from the old name |
| `--dry-run` | Show every change as a diff without writing anything |
| `--no-verify` | Skip armemon's checks on the result (they run by default) |
| `--json` | Print only a JSON summary on stdout (implies --all-accept) |
| `--all-accept` | Take every default instead of asking |

```bash
armemon rename-screen Order Invoice
# rename, and give it a new URL at the same time
armemon rename-screen Order Invoice --link invoice/:id
# rename, but leave the deep-link path alone
armemon rename-screen Order Invoice --keep-link
```

### `armemon plugin add [plugin]`

Add a plugin, wired in exactly as init would have

| Argument | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `[plugin]` | Plugin id or package name — redux *(optional — you are asked if you leave it out)* |

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--logo <path>` | Splash logo image, relative to where you run this |
| `--dir <path>` | The app directory (defaults to the nearest one at or above here) |
| `--dry-run` | Show every file, edit and package the change involves, without writing anything |
| `--force` | Go ahead past files you've changed, leaving each one as it is and listing it |
| `--no-verify` | Skip armemon's checks on the result (they run by default) |
| `--json` | Print only a JSON summary on stdout (implies --all-accept) |
| `--all-accept` | Take the plugin's default answers instead of asking |

```bash
armemon plugin add redux
# see every file, edit and package first
armemon plugin add navigation --dry-run
# default answers, JSON out, for a script
armemon plugin add essentials --json
# the splash screen with your logo
armemon plugin add splash --logo ./assets/logo.png
```

### `armemon create-slice [name]`

Create a Redux slice and register it in your store config

| Argument | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `[name]` | Slice name — cart, cartSlice, or cart-items *(optional — you are asked if you leave it out)* |

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--dir <path>` | The app directory (defaults to the nearest one at or above here) |
| `--no-register` | Write the slice file without touching the store config |
| `--force` | Replace the slice file if it already exists |
| `--dry-run` | Show every change as a diff without writing anything |

| `--json` | Print only a JSON summary on stdout (implies --all-accept) |
| `--all-accept` | Take every default instead of asking |

```bash

# write the file, leave the store config alone
armemon create-slice cart --no-register
# replace a slice file that already exists
armemon create-slice cart --force
```

### `armemon set [option] [value]`

Set one option in a plugin's config

| Argument | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `[option]` | Plugin option — ui.themeMode, essentials.notifications.position *(optional — you are asked if you leave it out)* |
| `[value]` | The value — dark, 18, true *(optional — you are asked if you leave it out)* |

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--dir <path>` | The app directory (defaults to the nearest one at or above here) |
| `--raw` | Use the value as code rather than inferring a literal (e.g. __DEV__) |
| `--force` | Replace a value that is a function or a call |
| `--dry-run` | Show the change as a diff without writing anything |
| `--no-verify` | Skip armemon's checks on the result (they run by default) |
| `--json` | Print only a JSON summary on stdout (implies --all-accept) |
| `--all-accept` | Take every default instead of asking |

```bash
armemon set ui.themeMode dark
armemon set ui.baseFontSize 18
# a nested option
armemon set essentials.notifications.position bottom
# an expression rather than a literal
armemon set redux.devTools __DEV__ --raw
# replace a value that is currently a function
armemon set redux.middleware undefined --force
```
